name: erc-chart-desktop-app
description: ERC Chart Windows desktop charting application monorepo

scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages docs/development tools/*.mjs tools/application-gates tools/delivery-governance tools/packaging tools/workspace-boundaries .github/workflows package.json tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.tests.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs README.md
scripts.lint: npm run boundaries:check && eslint apps packages tools/*.mjs tools/application-gates tools/delivery-governance tools/packaging tools/workspace-boundaries eslint.config.mjs
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && node --test tools/delivery-governance/test/*.test.mjs apps/desktop/test/*.test.mjs packages/contracts/test/*.test.mjs packages/data-service/test/*.test.mjs packages/electron-main/test/*.test.mjs packages/indicator-sdk/test/*.test.mjs packages/preload/test/*.test.mjs packages/provider-runtime/test/*.test.mjs packages/provider-sdk/test/*.test.mjs packages/renderer/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.package:win: npm run build:runtime && node tools/packaging/prepare-package.mjs && electron-builder --config tools/packaging/electron-builder.config.mjs --win nsis --x64 --publish never
